title: Document reply_to validation precondition in MessageStore::insert
description:
Location: crates/kith-store/src/message.rs, line 74

The insert() function accepts a reply_to parameter but has no doc comment documenting the precondition that reply_to (if present) must reference a valid message in the same chat.

Per project instructions (CLAUDE.md, defensive input handling section): 'Validate the referenced ID exists before storing'.

The function should document:
- reply_to must be validated by caller to exist in the same chat before calling insert()
- If validation is not done, data consistency is compromised
